acceptedCandidates.name: Google app for desktop
acceptedCandidates.identityReason: Official Google product page names a distinct Windows desktop app for Lens, AI-powered responses, computer/Drive search and a keyboard shortcut; no matching productId or alias exists under the existing Google vendor.
acceptedCandidates.officialWindowsEvidence: The product page states it is available on a Windows 10+ desktop device and the official script builds the exact dl.google.com installer path.
needsReview: Confirm final product naming/branding before catalog import.
Desktop manager must review the stable installer under the signed-catalog contract; this candidate grants no install permission.

reviewQueue.name: agents-cli
reviewQueue.officialIdentity: Google LLC standalone CLI package google-agents-cli for building, evaluating and deploying agents; the README explicitly says it is a tool for coding agents, not an agent itself.
reviewQueue.windowsSupport: WSL 2 only; native Windows is not officially supported.
reviewQueue.reason: Google Getting Started limits support to macOS, Linux and Windows via WSL 2; native Windows is not officially supported. Setup installs skills globally or in a workspace and update uses npx; no managed uninstall or data-boundary contract was found. Existing Windows python-venv or other fixed drivers cannot safely express this lifecycle.

rejectedOrMerged.name: Amazon Q Developer CLI / Q CLI
rejectedOrMerged.reason: AWS's current official documentation states that the Q CLI has become the Kiro CLI; creating amazon-q-cli would duplicate the existing Kiro CLI identity.

rejectedOrMerged.name: Hermes Desktop / Hermes Agent
rejectedOrMerged.reason: Existing directory identities cover the visual desktop product and independent CLI/Agent; no new vendor or alias is created.
